metadata.name: fivetran_platform__audit_table
metadata.comment: Table replacing the deprecated `fivetran_audit` table. Each record represents a table written  to during a connection sync, tracking timestamps and row counts. Note: Row counts may differ  from the deprecated `fivetran_audit`, which reported pre-duplicate data loads.

connection_id.name: connection_id
connection_id.comment: System generated unique ID of the connection.

schema_name.name: schema_name
schema_name.comment: Name of the schema. If not provided, the `connection_name` is used.

table_name.name: table_name
table_name.comment: Name of the table being written to during the sync.

destination_id.name: destination_id
destination_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the destination receiving data from the connection.

destination_name.name: destination_name
destination_name.comment: Name of the destination receiving data from the connection.

write_to_table_start.name: write_to_table_start
write_to_table_start.comment: Timestamp when Fivetran started writing to the table during a sync.

write_to_table_end.name: write_to_table_end
write_to_table_end.comment: Timestamp when Fivetran finished writing to the table during a sync.

sync_start.name: sync_start
sync_start.comment: Timestamp when the connection-level sync began writing or modifying records in the table.

sync_end.name: sync_end
sync_end.comment: Timestamp when the connection-level sync successfully completed writing or modifying records in the table.

sum_rows_replaced_or_inserted.name: sum_rows_replaced_or_inserted
sum_rows_replaced_or_inserted.comment: Total number of rows replaced or inserted into the table during a sync.

sum_rows_updated.name: sum_rows_updated
sum_rows_updated.comment: Total number of rows updated in the table during a sync.

sum_rows_deleted.name: sum_rows_deleted
sum_rows_deleted.comment: Total number of rows deleted from the table during a sync.

unique_table_sync_key.name: unique_table_sync_key
unique_table_sync_key.comment: Primary key of the table, hashed on `schema_name`, `connection_id`, `destination_id`, `table_name`, and `unique_table_sync_key`.

write_to_table_start_day.name: write_to_table_start_day
write_to_table_start_day.comment: The `write_to_table_start` field truncated to the `day`, used for partitioning with the `insert_overwrite` incremental method.

metadata.name: fivetran_platform__audit_trail_enriched
metadata.comment: Table of user actions performed within your Fivetran account, enriched with the human-readable names of the resources involved and the user who performed each action. Each event references a primary resource (the container, e.g. an `ACCOUNT`) and an optional secondary resource (the member, e.g. a `USER` added to a `TEAM`). This model resolves both resource references to their names when the resource type is a `CONNECTION`, `DESTINATION`, `USER`, or `ACCOUNT`. This table is only available on the Enterprise plan and above.

unique_audit_trail_key.name: unique_audit_trail_key
unique_audit_trail_key.comment: Surrogate key hashed on `audit_trail_id` and `captured_at` to uniquely identify each audit trail event.

audit_trail_id.name: audit_trail_id
audit_trail_id.comment: Identifier of the audit trail event.

captured_at.name: captured_at
captured_at.comment: Timestamp when the action was performed.

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the `user` who performed the action.

actor_email.name: actor_email
actor_email.comment: Account email of the user who performed the action. Only available when the `user` source table is enabled.

actor_first_name.name: actor_first_name
actor_first_name.comment: Given name of the user who performed the action. Only available when the `user` source table is enabled.

actor_last_name.name: actor_last_name
actor_last_name.comment: Surname of the user who performed the action. Only available when the `user` source table is enabled.

action.name: action
action.comment: The type of operation performed. Possible values include `CREATE`, `EDIT`, and `DELETE`.

interaction_method.name: interaction_method
interaction_method.comment: How the action was performed. Possible values include `WEB_UI`, `API`, and `SYSTEM`.

primary_resource_type.name: primary_resource_type
primary_resource_type.comment: The main type of resource (the container) affected by the action (e.g., `ACCOUNT`, `DESTINATION`, `CONNECTION`, `TEAM`, `USER`, `TRANSFORMATION`, `ROLE`, `EXTERNAL_LOG_SERVICE`).

primary_resource_id.name: primary_resource_id
primary_resource_id.comment: Identifier of the primary resource affected by the action.

primary_resource_name.name: primary_resource_name
primary_resource_name.comment: Name of the primary resource, resolved from `primary_resource_id` when `primary_resource_type` is a `CONNECTION`, `DESTINATION`, `ACCOUNT`, or `USER` (the user's email). Null for resource types without a name lookup or when the resource no longer exists.

secondary_resource_type.name: secondary_resource_type
secondary_resource_type.comment: The type of secondary resource (the member) affected by the action, if applicable.

secondary_resource_id.name: secondary_resource_id
secondary_resource_id.comment: Identifier of the secondary resource affected by the action, if applicable.

secondary_resource_name.name: secondary_resource_name
secondary_resource_name.comment: Name of the secondary resource, resolved from `secondary_resource_id` when `secondary_resource_type` is a `CONNECTION`, `DESTINATION`, `ACCOUNT`, or `USER` (the user's email). Null for resource types without a name lookup or when the resource no longer exists.

old_values.name: old_values
old_values.comment: JSON-like string of the resource's attributes before the action.

new_values.name: new_values
new_values.comment: JSON-like string of the resource's attributes after the action.

_fivetran_synced.name: _fivetran_synced
_fivetran_synced.comment: Timestamp when the record was last synced.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table
